apps.name: Reynard Browser
apps.subtitle: An experimental Gecko-based web browser for iOS 13+.
apps.localizedDescription:
Reynard is a Gecko-based mobile web browser for iOS 13+.

Unlike other browsers on iOS that are forced to use Apple's WebKit engine (including Safari and all third-party browsers), Reynard uses Gecko. This is the same engine that powers the Firefox browser on desktop and Android devices.

This is mainly for users on older iOS versions who are stuck with an outdated version of WebKit. Because WebKit is bundled with the OS, these devices cannot receive engine updates and often fail to load modern websites. By using Gecko which is kept up to date independently, Reynard allows these sites to work again. Users on newer iOS versions can also use the browser if they want an alternative browser engine on their device.

Source code is available on GitHub at https://github.com/minh-ton/reynard-browser.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Camera access lets websites in this browser scan QR codes, capture photos, and start video calls.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Microphone access lets websites in this browser capture your voice for calls and audio recordings.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Photo library access lets this browser save images and other media you download from websites to Photos.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Photo library access lets this browser upload photos and videos from your library and save images and other media you download from websites to Photos.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Location access lets websites in this browser provide location-based content such as maps, directions, and nearby places.
privacy.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Bluetooth access lets websites in this browser connect to nearby Bluetooth devices.

## Changes

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/minh-ton/reynard-browser/compare/0.22.1...0.23.1

### New Features
- You can now open multiple browser windows on iPadOS.
- You can now customize the toolbar by adding more buttons or replacing existing ones.
- Videos now play in the native iOS video player when in full screen, with Picture-in-Picture support for videos that allow it.
- Added more DNS over HTTPS providers, including Quad9 and AdGuard (by @SingularHomology).

### Bug Fixes & Improvements
- Improved GPU performance significantly by launching the GPU process as foreground, in which iOS does not impose GPU resource limits.
- Improved the reliability of iCloud Passwords autofill when switching between fields on a login form.
- The tab overview, tab bar, and sidebar now respect the Reduce Motion accessibility setting.
- Reordering tabs by dragging them in the tab bar is now easier.
- The media controls on the Lock Screen and in Control Center now show a Live status for livestreams.
- Page rendering is no longer throttled when the device is hot, as this was triggered too often.
- Navigating back or forward is now more reliable, and opening a link from a link preview no longer causes the previous page to reload when going back.
- Fixed an issue where swiping from the screen edges to navigate back or forward would show a stale preview, or show the page before the swipe finished.
- Fixed an issue where the crashed page error would appear even after the page was automatically recovered.
- Fixed an issue where the scrollbar thumb would oscillate while scrolling, jump when dragged, or sit beneath the browser toolbars.
- Fixed an issue where an add-on icon that failed to load would make the address bar menu refresh repeatedly, causing high CPU usage.
- Fixed several UI issues.

### Translations
Added Korean translation.

### Engine
Updated Gecko to [161.0](https://github.com/mozilla-firefox/firefox/commit/FIREFOX_161_0_RELEASE) (released Nov 24, 2026).

## Changes

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/minh-ton/reynard-browser/compare/0.22.0...0.22.1

- Online PDF files now open in the mobile PDF viewer instead of the desktop version.
- Links with custom URL schemes can now open in their corresponding apps on your device.

### Bug Fixes & Improvements
- WebGL content is now rendered using Apple’s Metal graphics API through ANGLE, which can improve performance on some sites.
- Made minor performance optimizations, particularly when the browser is in the background or the device is hot.
- Fixed an issue where add-on update checks would always report that no updates were available.
- Fixed an issue where typing Vietnamese in rich text editors or contenteditable elements could duplicate characters when entering accents or pressing Backspace.
- Fixed an issue where the browser could not connect to any websites when DNS over HTTPS was enabled with Max Protection.

- Fixed an issue where right-clicking with a mouse or trackpad would not bring up the webpage's own context menu.

## Changes

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/minh-ton/reynard-browser/compare/0.4.0...0.5.0

### New Features
- Added WebRTC support.
- Added W3C touch events support.
- Added Vietnamese input method support.
- Added JIT enablement support for iOS 27.
- Added support for selecting and copying text on a webpage.
- Added support for ProMotion displays and adaptive refresh rates.

- Added Camera, Microphone, Location, and Motion & Orientation Sensors support. You can manage these permissions per site through the new **Website Settings** pane in the address bar menu. For all websites, see **Site Permissions** in the browser settings.

- Search suggestions now appear for queries typed into the address bar. You can also choose the search suggestion provider among Google, Bing, Yahoo, and more. Bookmarks and history entries also appear as suggestions.

### Bug Fixes & Improvements
- Improved iPadOS Split Screen and Slide Over layout support.
- Improved the speed of switching between tabs using the tab bar.
- Improved the tab deletion and new tab workflow in the tab overview.
- Improved the Developer Disk Image mount state check before JIT enablement.
- Improved JIT stability so tab crashes would be less likely to happen mid-use on some devices on iOS 26 or later.
- Fixed an issue where automatic JIT enablement on iOS 17.0 would cause the browser to malfunction (by @StayBlue).
- Webpages no longer stall on network changes, such as transitioning from Wi-Fi to Cellular or switching between Wi-Fi networks.
- Fixed an issue where the add-on popup could not be opened after opening a website from a link preview.
- Text selection highlights inside text input fields are now cleared properly on iOS 16 and older.
- The device touch capability is now correctly reported to websites.
- Fixed an issue where links that open in a new tab automatically would not display their content.
- Rich text copied from the browser no longer appears as gibberish when pasted into another app.
- Fixed an issue where opening a preview link would load the mobile version of the site instead of inheriting the website mode settings.
- Fixed an issue where you cannot move a Favorites bookmark item to a new folder.
- Fixed various UI issues:

    - Fixed an issue where top address bar mode in portrait on iPhone would cause the tab overview dismiss animation to be scaled incorrectly.

### Deprecations
- You can no longer enable JIT with a pairing file on iOS 17.3.1 or older. Users on TrollStore-supported versions are recommended to use the TrollStore build for automatic JIT enablement.

## Changes

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/minh-ton/reynard-browser/compare/0.3.0...0.4.0

### iOS Support
Thanks to @ifilipis, Reynard Browser now supports iOS 13! On iOS 13, sideloading the Reynard-Jailbroken.ipa build on a **jailbroken device** is recommended for the best performance and automatic JIT enablement. Use [Filza File Manager](https://www.tigisoftware.com/default/?page_id=78) with [AppSync](https://github.com/akemin-dayo/AppSync) to install.

### New Features
- Added Private Browsing mode, accessible from the tab switcher.
- Added Bookmarks. Bookmark a website by tapping **Add Bookmark** or **Add to Favorites** in the address bar menu. Access your bookmarks from the sidebar on iPad or the 3-dot menu on the toolbar on iPhone.
- Added the ability to clear the history list directly from the History page.
- Added the ability to open the Downloads folder directly from the Downloads page, with an option to clear the Downloads list. Downloaded files can also be opened using the Files app.
- Added tab reordering. Long press a tab on the tab bar or from the tab switcher to reorganize your tab list.
- Improved tab switcher animations.
- Added link and image previews. Long press on a link or an image to preview, open in a new tab, save, or share.
- Added support for installing add-ons using XPI or ZIP package files.

### Bug Fixes
- Fixed an issue where screen auto-lock would trigger during full screen mode.
- Fixed an issue where the forward and backward buttons would not work on an existing tab after browser startup.
- Fixed an issue where multi-tap gestures would require an additional tap to activate at first.
- Fixed an issue where JIT enablement on iOS 26 would fail to recognize the mount state of the Developer Disk Image.
- The in-app updater in the TrollStore sideloading build now uses TrollStore's URL Scheme to perform updates. Make sure the **URL Scheme Enabled** option is enabled in TrollStore.
- Removed the forced default user agent override to allow add-ons that configure Gecko's user agent to work properly or to set the user agent manually when **Use Android User Agent** is turned off.
- Fixed an issue where **Request Desktop/Mobile Website** would not switch modes correctly on some websites.
- Fixed an issue where opening the camera for file input would always allow both video recording and image capture instead of respecting the accepted file types.
- Fixed various UI issues, especially on the iPad layout.

### Engine
- Updated Gecko to [FIREFOX_151_0_RELEASE@79eeaf7](https://github.com/mozilla-firefox/firefox/commit/FIREFOX_151_0_RELEASE) (released May 19, 2026).

## Changes

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/minh-ton/reynard-browser/compare/0.2.0...0.3.0

### New Features
- Added Firefox add-ons support. To install an add-on, go to **Settings → Add-ons → Discover Add-ons**, then visit an add-on page and tap **Add to Firefox**.
- Redesigned the address bar. There is now a new menu button on the left for quick access to features like Add-ons, and a reload/stop button on the right. A keyboard dismiss button is also added for the top address bar.
- Added a new Request Desktop/Mobile Website feature, accessible from the address bar menu.
- Websites will now display in desktop mode on iPads by default.
- Added video fullscreen mode support.
- Added support for JavaScript alert(), prompt(), and confirm() popups.

### Bug Fixes
- Fixed an issue where the keyboard would retract on numerical OTP input fields.
- Fixed an issue where text input fields wouldn't reposition above the keyboard when the address bar is on top.
- Fixed and improved various browser UI issues.

- Updated Gecko to [FIREFOX_150_0_2_RELEASE@d269b4d](https://github.com/mozilla-firefox/firefox/commit/FIREFOX_150_0_2_RELEASE) (released May 7, 2026).

## Changes
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/minh-ton/reynard-browser/compare/0.1.0...0.2.0

### Engine
- Added WebGPU support.
- Improved overall performance, particularly in graphics rendering.
- Fixed an issue where 16-bit floating-point color buffers failed to render in WebGL. 
- Most media files and formats can now be played or streamed directly in the browser.
- Fixed the issue where a single tap would be registered as a double tap (for real this time).
- Raised jetsam memory limits for child processes when the app is sideloaded via TrollStore.
- Fixed crashes when visiting certain websites or playing audio with uncommon sample rates.
- The iOS system font now renders correctly on websites using ‎-apple-system or ‎system-ui.
- Websites now consistently display their mobile layout instead of showing a mix of mobile and desktop versions.
- Added support for color, file, and date/time inputs. File inputs let you pick from your photo library, capture a photo or video with your camera, or browse files.
- Updated Gecko to [FIREFOX_150_0_RELEASE@9154e5a](https://github.com/mozilla-firefox/firefox/commit/FIREFOX_150_0_RELEASE) (released Apr 21, 2026).

### Browser
- Fixed numerous UI issues.
- Added in-app updates. When a new version is available, you can download and install it directly from the browser settings.
- Added browsing history. You can access your browsing history from the sidebar (on iPad) or the 3-dot menu in the bottom toolbar (on iPhone).
- Brought back the "Use Android User Agent" option, which is enabled for all websites by default for better compatibility. When this option is turned off, advanced users can configure this per-site via the "User Agent Overrides" setting.

## Changes
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/minh-ton/reynard-browser/compare/0.0.1-a2...0.1.0

### Engine
- Added clipboard support.
- Fixed the issue where media playback would not have sound.
- Allowed media playback to be controlled from the Control Center or Lock Screen.
- Fixed crashes when submitting forms or tapping on some HTML elements.
- Fixed an issue where a single tap would be registered as a double tap.
- Added select menus support (HTML <select> element).
- Added native text selection and copy/paste/select-all support for editable text fields (HTML <input> and <textarea> elements).
- Updated Gecko to [FIREFOX_149_0_2_RELEASE@d8bbe6c](https://github.com/mozilla-firefox/firefox/commit/FIREFOX_149_0_2_RELEASE) (released Apr 7, 2026).

### JIT
- Added support for RPPairing, allowing users on iOS 26.4+ to enable JIT. If you're on iOS 17.4+, you will have to recreate a new pairing file using the latest version of [iloader](https://iloader.app/).
- JIT is now automatically enabled for users who sideload using TrollStore (without using the Enable JIT option from TrollStore). Therefore the pairing file and LocalDevVPN is no longer needed.

### Browser
- Added support for downloading files from websites.
- Added proper tab management with tab list restoration on startup.
- Users can now open links in Reynard browser from other apps via the share sheet.
- Fixed numerous user interface issues.
- Added new iPhone-only settings which allow placing the address bar on top and hiding the tab bar on horizontal mode.
- Added a new setting to allow users to selectively use the Firefox on Android user agent on only some websites to maintain engine compatibility.

## Issues
-  I don't know if there is any bug on the new editable support on iOS 16 and 17 or not as I don't have devices on these versions to test, so feel free to open an issue if you experience issues with text edit fields on these versions. Also, due to numerous API changes on iOS/iPadOS 15.0, 16.0, and 17.0, there are quite a few unimplemented features and issues with text input fields:
    - Dragging the spacebar to move the cursor to a different position is unimplemented.
    - Triple-tapping to select a paragraph is unimplemented.
    - Selection handle switching during dragging (cross-switching) on iOS 16+ is currently not working.
    - Touch and hold the caret to magnify the text or move is unimplemented.
